To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the performance of graduates' employment is affected by both human capital and capital family, and the effect of the two is different.
the human and family capital have positive and significant effects on students' employment policy.
the human capital, family capital and performance of graduates' employment have significant effects on each other.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship among human capital,family and the performance of the employment policy,and it provides some reference for the formulation of the policy of the government and universities.
the relationship among the family capital,human capital and the performance in graduates' employment policy.
the impact of human capital on graduates' employment policy,and we have also made a further study on the impact of family capital.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the human capital,families and the performance of graduates' employment policies are closely related to each other, and the human capital and family background of graduates are two important factors in the process of graduates employment policy.

the family capital has a significant positive effect on graduates' self-employment aspiration,desire for work in grassroots community and areas of difficulty,but a negative effect on graduates' desire to go to work at the West.
both human capital,as the basis for employment, and family capital,as the support for employment, are important factors that determine the graduates' employment policy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the government should provide more policy support to the graduates with lower human capital and family background,while universities should provide more guidance for the graduates with lower family capital and higher human capital.
the human capital and family background are two important factors that affect the performance of graduates' employment.
the human capital and the family capital have significant influence on graduates' employment policy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the family capital has a significant positive impact on the performance of students’ employment policy.
the family capital is the main factor affecting the students' employment policy.
the family capital has a significant impact on the graduates' employment policy.
